intent: Mutating an accented 303 NOTE whose SLIDE target becomes REST must clear only SLIDE, not the separately programmed ACCENT. A valid slide into a NOTE stays intact.
reason: tb3po_mutate previously assigned G_NOTE when cleaning an orphan slide, silently deleting an independent BS_ACCENT bit.
design: In tb3po_mutate cleanup only, clear BS_SLIDE bit. Do not change generation, RNG draws, pattern serialization, structure layout, clock, MIDI or installer logic.

method.source: actual Git-SHA-matched production C, with real tb3po_mutate called through linked host executable; no synthetic reimplementation of target
method.stimulus: 4096 reproducible mutation seeds; 3072 cases where the source note was not re-rolled; 2536 orphan-slide outcomes; 2543 legitimate slide outcomes; manually programmed accent/velocity, no-accent controls, anchored RNG stream, 64 seeded generator deterministic controls.

coverage_limitations: The full current Git checkout tests/run_tests.sh runner was not executed by the producer; a command with the same GCC warning/profile flags was independently executed against matched production C.
No complete-root QA or Independent QA approval.
No new Elite/Pro target firmware/controller build or package verification.
No hardware, browser installer, sample backup, OTA or publication verification.

ownership.source_owner: Hourly Bugfinder, this isolated lane only
ownership.next_builder: existing Hourly Build, fresh Elite/Pro/controller BUILD_ONLY for changed compiler tree; no downstream gate prerequisite
ownership.next_qa: existing Independent QA, independent review and actual complete-root path
ownership.integration: existing sole firmware Safe Merge only; no source merge authority transferred
